name: Pork Humba
description: A classic Filipino braised pork dish that balances sweet, sour, and umami flavors. The pork belly absorbs the sauce made from soy sauce, vinegar, brown sugar, and aromatic herbs, resulting in tender meat with a glossy glaze.

name: Banana Cue
description: A classic Filipino street snack featuring deep‑fried saba bananas coated in caramelized sugar. Crispy on the outside, sweet and fragrant inside, often served skewered on small bamboo sticks or sticks of bamboo or plastic. Ideal for parties, fiestas, or a quick midnight munch.

name: Pork Igado
description: Igado is a hearty Filipino stew that originates from the Ilocano region, combining pork belly, pork liver, carrots, and green peas in a savory soy sauce base. It is known for its comforting flavor and convenient preparation, making it a staple in family meals.

name: Sinigang na Alimango
description: A tangy, tomato-based crab soup flavored with tamarind broth, fresh vegetables, and a touch of heat—perfect for a comforting Filipino meal.

name: Adobong Kangkong
description: Water spinach cooked adobo-style in soy sauce, vinegar, and garlic.

name: Adobong Mais
description: A beloved Filipino dish that transforms sweet corn into a savory, slightly tangy stew, perfect as a side or main dish with rice.

name: Halabos Alimango
description: Steamed mud crabs cooked simply in their own juices with a little salt and lemon-lime soda.

name: Ginataang Tuna
description: A comforting Filipino stew with silky coconut milk, tender pieces of fresh tuna, and a medley of starchy vegetables, all seasoned with garlic, ginger, and a hint of fish sauce for a savory depth.

name: Pancit Canton
description: A savory stir‑fried noodle dish featuring a blend of pork, shrimp, and fresh vegetables, seasoned with soy and fish sauce.

name: Tortang Giniling
description: Filipino ground pork omelet mixed with vegetables, pan-fried until golden.

name: Beef Steak
description: Filipino beef steak marinated in soy sauce and calamansi, topped with onion rings.

name: Bicol Express
description: Spicy pork stew cooked in coconut milk and shrimp paste with lots of chilies.

name: Pork Adobo
description: A classic Filipino comfort dish where pork is braised in a savory mixture of soy sauce, vinegar, garlic, and bay leaves until it becomes tender and flavorful. The balance of saltiness, acidity, and subtle sweetness makes it a beloved staple, especially when paired with steaming hot rice.
